'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] begin [[emergency evacuation|evacuating]] thousands of [[civilian]]s from occupied areas of [[Kherson Oblast]], according to Russian-installed governor [[Volodymyr Saldo]]. Ukraine calls on residents to ignore the Russian orders to leave their towns and villages. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63311744 (BBC News)]
***[[2022 Russian martial law]]
****[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] introduces [[Martial law in Russia|martial law]], beginning Thursday at midnight, in the [[Russian annexation of Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts|recently annexed]] territories of [[Ukraine]]. Additionally, an "intermediate level of preparedness" is introduced in [[Crimea]] and the [[Federal subjects of Russia|federal subjects]] bordering Ukraine. [https://apnews.com/b48b555f547ff6a1a59b1cad17d0e269 (AP)] [https://theins.ru/news/256185 (''The Insider'')]
*[[2022 Haitian crisis]], [[Bahamas–Haiti relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of the Bahamas]] [[Philip Davis (Bahamian politician)|Philip Davis]] says that he is ready to send [[Royal Bahamas Defence Force|troops]] to [[Haiti]] as part of a peacekeeping force if asked to do so by the [[Caribbean Community]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bahamas-would-send-troops-haiti-if-asked-minister-says-2022-10-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Three staff members and five visitors are killed by two bomb explosions inside [[Insein Prison]] in [[Yangon]], [[Myanmar]]. Ten others are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/19/at-least-8-killed-in-myanmar-insein-prison-blast-media-reports (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[European Parliament]] awards the [[Sakharov Prize]] to "the people of [[Ukraine]]". [https://www.politico.eu/article/european-parliament-awards-this-years-sakharov-prize-to-the-ukrainian-people/ (Politico)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Belarusian involvement in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Belarus]] says that it is unable to pay off its debt because of [[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|international sanctions imposed]] due to its role in the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-says-it-is-unable-pay-off-debt-due-sanctions-2022-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Inflation]] in the [[United Kingdom]] rises to 10.1%, the highest recorded level since 1982, amid a [[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis|cost of living crisis]] and sharp increases in food prices, according to the [[Office for National Statistics]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/oct/19/uk-inflation-rises-energy-bills-food-prices-september-cost-of-living-crisis (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Central American migrant caravans]]
**Three [[Venezuelan]] migrants are killed and five others are injured in a van accident on a [[highway]] in [[Chiapas]], [[Mexico]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/venezuelan-migrants-killed-mexico-highway-accident-91765817 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Indonesia|Indonesian]] [[Ministry of Health (Indonesia)|Health Ministry]] announces that 99 children have died this year due to [[acute kidney injury]] with the deaths being linked to [[Cold medicine|paracetamol syrups]] used to treat fevers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-says-74-children-have-died-acute-kidney-injury-this-year-2022-10-19/ (Reuters)]
*An outbreak of [[cholera]] has killed five people in [[Lebanon]], with a total of 169 cases. It is the first outbreak in the country since 1995. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/19/lebanon-warns-deadly-cholera-outbreak-spreading-rapidly (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Phnom Penh]], [[Cambodia]] sentences opposition figure [[Sam Rainsy]] to [[life in prison]] for "attempting to concede territory to a foreign entity". The sentence was delivered ''[[Trial in absentia|in absentia]]'' because Rainsy has been living in exile in [[France]] since 2015. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2418211/cambodia-court-sentences-exiled-opposition-figure-rainsy-to-life-in-jail (AFP via ''The Bangkok Post'')]

***[[Suella Braverman]] resigns as [[Home Secretary]] of the [[United Kingdom]] and is replaced by [[Grant Shapps]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/oct/19/suella-braverman-departs-as-uk-home-secretary-liz-truss (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Same-sex marriage in Mexico]]
